::: {#def-rnffrcitg .theorem}
## RNFFRCISTG model

A random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal{C}=(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)})$ of an RNNPSEM $\mathcal{M}$, where $\mathcal{M}$ satisfies (1) no contagion, (2) homogeneous random network interference, (3) identical structural distributions, and (4) single-world independence, with each graph generator taken as a single variable: C.13 is applied to the DAG in which each block $\boldsymbol{\psi}_t$ is one node, whose one-step-ahead counterfactual is the matrix $\boldsymbol{\psi}_t^{(\mathbf{pa})}$.
:::
